Army Chief General Dwivedi bids farewell, new chief takes charge

General Upendra Dwivedi has retired after a distinguished career, handing over the reins of the Indian Army to Lieutenant General Dhiraj Seth. During his farewell, General Dwivedi reflected on the Army's operational readiness and integration, while also discussing the ongoing situation and management of the India-China border. The transition marks a significant moment for the Indian military leadership.
